l4_steps.name: Project Initiation
l4_steps.input: Project proposal and requirements document
l4_steps.output: Project initiation report
l4_steps.kpi: Project start time within 2 weeks of approval
l4_steps.pain_point: Delays in project initiation due to inadequate planning.

l4_steps.name: Feasibility Study
l4_steps.input: Project initiation report
l4_steps.output: Feasibility study report
l4_steps.kpi: Completion of feasibility study within 4 weeks
l4_steps.pain_point: Resource constraints affecting the feasibility study timeline.

l4_steps.name: Conceptual Design
l4_steps.input: Feasibility study report
l4_steps.output: Conceptual design drawings
l4_steps.kpi: Completion of conceptual designs within 3 weeks
l4_steps.pain_point: Design conflicts with existing aircraft systems.

l4_steps.name: Regulatory Compliance Check
l4_steps.input: Conceptual design drawings
l4_steps.output: Compliance report
l4_steps.kpi: Regulatory approval within 2 months
l4_steps.pain_point: Non-compliance with aviation regulations.

l4_steps.name: Detailed Design
l4_steps.input: Conceptual design drawings, compliance report
l4_steps.output: Detailed design drawings
l4_steps.kpi: Completion of detailed designs within 4 weeks
l4_steps.pain_point: Technical issues during detailed design.

l4_steps.name: Prototype Development
l4_steps.input: Detailed design drawings
l4_steps.output: Prototype model
l4_steps.kpi: Prototype completion within 6 weeks
l4_steps.pain_point: Manufacturing defects in prototype.

l4_steps.name: Prototype Testing
l4_steps.input: Prototype model
l4_steps.output: Test report
l4_steps.kpi: Prototype testing completion within 4 weeks
l4_steps.pain_point: Failed prototype tests leading to redesign.

l4_steps.name: Final Design Approval
l4_steps.input: Test report
l4_steps.output: Final design approval document
l4_steps.kpi: Final design approval within 1 week of testing completion
l4_steps.pain_point: Delays in final design approval due to additional reviews.

l4_steps.name: Procurement Plan
l4_steps.input: Final design drawings, budget allocation
l4_steps.output: Procurement plan and supplier list
l4_steps.kpi: Supplier selection within 3 weeks
l4_steps.pain_point: Difficulty in finding suitable suppliers.

l4_steps.name: Manufacturing Execution
l4_steps.input: Procurement plan, final design drawings
l4_steps.output: Completed cabin reconfiguration kits
l4_steps.kpi: Completion of manufacturing within 8 weeks
l4_steps.pain_point: Manufacturing delays due to material shortages.

l4_steps.name: Aircraft Installation
l4_steps.input: Completed cabin reconfiguration kits, aircraft maintenance records
l4_steps.output: Installation report
l4_steps.kpi: Installation completion within 5 days per aircraft
l4_steps.pain_point: Installation issues leading to additional downtime.

l4_steps.name: Post-Installation Testing
l4_steps.input: Installation report
l4_steps.output: Post-installation test report
l4_steps.kpi: Testing completion within 3 days per aircraft

l4_steps.name: Operational Training
l4_steps.input: Post-installation test report
l4_steps.output: Training program and materials
l4_steps.kpi: Training completion within 2 weeks
l4_steps.pain_point: Insufficient training resources.

l4_steps.name: Final Acceptance and Documentation
l4_steps.input: Training program, operational feedback
l4_steps.output: Final acceptance report
l4_steps.kpi: Project completion within 12 months from initiation
l4_steps.pain_point: Ongoing issues after implementation.

processes.description: The Cabin Reconfiguration Engineering process involves designing and implementing changes to aircraft cabin layouts to improve passenger experience or operational efficiency.
processes.trigger: Initiation of a new cabin reconfiguration project by the airline's engineering department.
processes.outcome: Successful completion produces a detailed design plan, regulatory approval, and implementation of the cabin reconfiguration on specified aircraft.
kpis: Project start time within 2 weeks of approval
Completion of feasibility study within 4 weeks
Final design approval within 1 week of testing completion
Installation completion within 5 days per aircraft
risks: Delays in project initiation due to inadequate planning.

l4_steps.name: Identify Affected Passengers
l4_steps.input: Flight status update from Operations Control Center
l4_steps.output: List of affected passengers
l4_steps.kpi: Time to identify affected passengers < 15 minutes
l4_steps.pain_point: Delayed identification can lead to increased passenger dissatisfaction

l4_steps.name: Assess Passenger Preferences
l4_steps.input: Passenger contact information from PSS system
l4_steps.output: Passenger preferences for re-accommodation (e.g., flight time, seat class)
l4_steps.kpi: 80% of passenger preferences captured within 30 minutes
l4_steps.pain_point: Missed preferences can lead to unsatisfied passengers

l4_steps.name: Determine Alternative Flights
l4_steps.input: Passenger preferences and availability data
l4_steps.output: List of alternative flights with optimal fit to passenger needs
l4_steps.kpi: 90% of passengers receive suitable alternative flights within 1 hour
l4_steps.pain_point: Inability to find suitable alternatives can lead to customer complaints

l4_steps.name: Notify Passengers of Re-accommodation Options
l4_steps.input: Alternative flights list from Flight Dispatcher
l4_steps.output: Notification sent to passengers with options and contact information for confirmation
l4_steps.kpi: 95% of notifications sent within 30 minutes of identifying alternatives
l4_steps.pain_point: Delayed notifications can cause passenger anxiety

l4_steps.name: Confirm Passenger Selections
l4_steps.input: Passenger responses to notification
l4_steps.output: Confirmed re-accommodation details
l4_steps.kpi: 85% of passengers confirm their selections within 1 hour
l4_steps.pain_point: Unconfirmed selections can lead to operational inefficiencies

l4_steps.name: Update Passenger Records
l4_steps.input: Confirmed re-accommodation details
l4_steps.output: Updated passenger records in PSS and CRM systems
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of passenger records updated within 30 minutes of confirmation
l4_steps.pain_point: Outdated records can lead to operational errors

l4_steps.name: Reserve Alternative Flights
l4_steps.input: Updated passenger records
l4_steps.output: Reserved seats on alternative flights
l4_steps.kpi: 98% of reserved seats confirmed within 1 hour of reservation
l4_steps.pain_point: Failed reservations can cause further delays

l4_steps.name: Generate Re-accommodation Tickets
l4_steps.input: Reserved seats and passenger details
l4_steps.output: Re-accommodation tickets issued
l4_steps.kpi: 95% of tickets issued within 2 hours of reservation confirmation
l4_steps.pain_point: Delayed ticket issuance can cause additional stress to passengers

l4_steps.name: Notify Passengers of Ticket Issuance
l4_steps.input: Issued tickets from Ticketing System
l4_steps.output: Notification sent to passengers with ticket details and boarding information
l4_steps.kpi: 90% of notifications sent within 30 minutes of ticket issuance
l4_steps.pain_point: Missed notifications can lead to missed flights

l4_steps.name: Monitor Passenger Check-in
l4_steps.input: Passenger check-in data from airport systems
l4_steps.output: Check-in status report for affected passengers
l4_steps.kpi: 95% of passengers checked in within 2 hours of ticket issuance
l4_steps.pain_point: Late check-ins can cause further disruptions

l4_steps.name: Review Re-accommodation Process
l4_steps.input: Process logs and passenger feedback
l4_steps.output: Process review report with recommendations
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of process reviews completed within 24 hours post-disruption
l4_steps.pain_point: Unreviewed processes can lead to repeated issues

l4_steps.name: Update Disruption Response Plan
l4_steps.role: Customer Service Manager, Operations Control Center
l4_steps.input: Process review report
l4_steps.output: Updated disruption response plan
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of plans updated within 7 days post-disruption
l4_steps.pain_point: Outdated plans can lead to inefficiencies in future disruptions

l4_steps.name: Communicate with Stakeholders
l4_steps.role: Customer Service Manager, Operations Control Center
l4_steps.input: Updated disruption response plan
l4_steps.output: Stakeholder communication report
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of stakeholders notified within 24 hours post-plan update
l4_steps.pain_point: Uncommunicated changes can lead to confusion

l4_steps.name: Monitor Passenger Satisfaction
l4_steps.input: Passenger feedback from post-disruption surveys
l4_steps.output: Satisfaction report with trends and insights
l4_steps.kpi: 90% response rate to satisfaction surveys within 1 week of disruption
l4_steps.pain_point: Low response rates can lead to incomplete data

processes.description: The process for re-accommodating passengers impacted by disruptions to ensure customer satisfaction and loyalty.
processes.trigger: Flight delay or cancellation affecting passengers
processes.outcome: Passengers are re-accommodated on alternative flights with minimal disruption, maintaining customer satisfaction.
kpis: Time to identify affected passengers < 15 minutes
80% of passenger preferences captured within 30 minutes
90% of passengers receive suitable alternative flights within 1 hour
95% of notifications sent within 30 minutes of identifying alternatives
85% of passengers confirm their selections within 1 hour
100% of passenger records updated within 30 minutes of confirmation
98% of reserved seats confirmed within 1 hour of reservation
95% of tickets issued within 2 hours of reservation confirmation
90% of notifications sent within 30 minutes of ticket issuance
95% of passengers checked in within 2 hours of ticket issuance
100% of process reviews completed within 24 hours post-disruption
100% of plans updated within 7 days post-disruption
100% of stakeholders notified within 24 hours post-plan update
90% response rate to satisfaction surveys within 1 week of disruption
risks: Operational delays in identifying affected passengers and preferences
Inability to find suitable alternative flights for all passengers
Failed reservations leading to further operational issues
Missed notifications causing additional stress to passengers
Late check-ins resulting in missed flights
Incomplete process reviews leading to repeated issues
Outdated disruption response plans causing inefficiencies
Uncommunicated changes leading to confusion among stakeholders
Low passenger satisfaction survey responses leading to incomplete data
